bear_case: The US launching fresh strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island — directly inside the Strait of Hormuz approach — is a qualitative escalation that the CPI relief cannot permanently offset. Iranian sea mines laid in late May are still physically present; one tanker incident or Iranian naval skirmish in the next 48 hours could push Brent above $97 in hours, instantly re-triggering the oil regime flag and forcing a HOLD → STEP ASIDE or BEARISH reversal before ORCL even reports. The S&P 500's estimated bounce to ~7,438 leaves SPX 22 points below the 7,460 regime floor — a gap-open that fades below 7,400 intraday would confirm the CPI relief as fully priced and then some. ORCL earnings after the close are an evening binary: a RPO guidance miss spreads macro concerns to software multiples and undercuts the 'AI capex is real' narrative at exactly the moment the market is re-risking. **Invalidation: If SPX closes above 7,460 today with VIX closing below 17, and ORCL guides RPO acceleration above $600B after the close, HOLD upgrades to BUY immediately. If Brent re-breaches $97 or SPX fades below 7,300 intraday on Iran news, HOLD converts to BEARISH on the next session open.**
